reported_results.observation: Hollow Knight launch, stream stop, Baba Is You launch and stop, and retained game switching worked.
Contra did not remain running; leaving its stream left the provider in stopping and blocked every later launch.
Hard close returned failure and did not retire the persistent provider barrier.

live_evidence: Playnite dispatched RetroArch with the configured fceumm core and Contra ROM, then reported that Contra stopped after four seconds.
Windows Application Error recorded retroarch.exe exception 0xc0000005 at module offset 0x414e70 immediately after launch.
The provider retained state=stopping with connectorStopPending=true and PID 11156 even though that exact PID no longer existed; the running inventory was partial.
Gateway hard reset failed with hard_reset_effect_unconfirmed because the provider rejected the identityless orphan as running_game_identity_unconfirmed.
root_causes: The provider had no bounded explicit-reset escape for a Playnite connector stop whose remembered PID was provably gone but whose inventory remained partial.
Contra itself was dispatched successfully but RetroArch crashed; game launch failure and S05 recovery failure are separate defects.
correction: Explicit fenced hard reset may retire only the exact current stopping+connectorStopPending record when its sole remembered PID is proven gone and no unrelated verified game exists.
Automatic reconciliation remains fail-closed unless an independent complete-empty inventory is available, preserving delayed emulator handoff and child ownership.
